prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: LEFT view, one image in a candidate four-view turntable pack of the SAME rigid marble statue.
References: image 1 front.png is the fixed FRONT camera azimuth 0; image 2 approved.png is the original exact same approved statue and geometry. Use both to preserve identity. Treat the statue as one immutable physical sculpture on an invisible turntable: rotate ONLY the CAMERA by +90 degrees around its vertical axis from FRONT. Camera convention: statue up is +Y; front camera=(0,h,+d), front image right corresponds to +X; LEFT +90 camera=(-d,h,0). This is the supporting-hand side view. The outstretched arm toward front-image right (+X) should now point away and be naturally foreshortened/occluded, never swing to a new pose. Do not just redraw the front or mirror it.
Fixed geometry: preserve the asymmetrical seated collapse with the original planted supporting palm on the front-image left, its straight load-bearing arm and exact wrist/palm; preserve both knees together and folded to the front-image right, overlapped feet, outstretched other arm with open hand, exact raised/turned-back head and anguish expression, hair curls, and original opaque tunic/drapery. No limb may move to improve visibility; natural occlusion is correct. Existing tunic securely covers torso/pelvis. Same proportions, age, pale warm marble pores/veins and carving. Hidden surfaces should be conservatively inferred from source, preserving the known silhouette geometry.
Camera and lighting: same low elevation and modest perspective as source; camera target and distance chosen to show the entire statue with at least 8 percent empty margin on all sides, neutral even catalog lighting. One left view only. Genuinely transparent alpha background, opaque marble and clean antialiased cutout edges; remove red/yellow fringe and halo.
Constraints: no mirroring, no reposing, no expression change, no new ornament, no base/plinth/pedestal, no ground, prop, environment, fog, glow, cast shadow, text, watermark, or extra objects.

landmark_check.reaching_arm: Recedes to the right but bends at elbow more than the near-straight original; open palm shape changes.
landmark_check.head_face: Head now shown in profile; source expression broadly retained but neck/head angle cannot be established as rigid.

Requested exact plus-90 camera orbit is not established; torso remains prominently frontal and view appears shallower than a full perpendicular side.
Finger shapes/spread, knee/foot overlap, hair carving and tunic folds differ across views.
Colored fringe and detached speckles persist.
Requested eight percent margin fails at top/right/bottom.

limitations: Candidate inferred imagery only. Novel views are not measured hidden geometry, a recovered 3D model, or guaranteed reconstruction-ready data. Four native generation calls total; no retries, mesh generation, pixel cleanup, or background compositing.
acceptance: Not accepted as a rigid geometrically consistent four-view reconstruction pack.
